verdict.rationale: The firm publishes some jurisdiction-specific startup resources, namely free downloadable UK and DE cap table templates. Its incentives page names UK tax-advantaged EMI schemes, but as an advisory service, not as published guidance on the rules. Missing for 10: actual published guides or articles on EMI rules, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules or French BSPCE, and any independent corroboration of jurisdiction-specific startup publications.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments and rules of my market — e.g. UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE

citations.quote: free downloadable "Cap table (UK version)" and "Cap table (DE version)"
tax-advantaged enterprise management incentive (EMI) and company share option plans
